scope: Arm only on a known genuine-drop veto from the selected previous rule. Persist for that episode/next-depth slot across timer eligibility or leaving resistance. Evaluate only at otherwise-approved add decisions. Release when original pulse predicate clears, or reset on episode/next-depth change. Exits/partials/gates unchanged.

rules.drop_confirm_both: Require taker15m >=1.2 AND taker1h >=1.0; no price-return condition
rules.drop_sr_confirm: Only within 0.3% below known resistance, require taker15m >=1.2 AND taker1h >=1.0 AND ret15m >0

coverage: Required pulse must meet prior-study sample/freshness tests. Unknown data cannot arm a new hold and cannot clear an armed hold; both are counted. Pulse cannot validate pre-HL history. Explicit receipt times respected; historical missing receipt modeled at window-end plus one minute. This is not certified live-arrival parity or a deployed missing-data policy.
diagnostics: Compare each persistent rule to unchanged baseline AND its exact same-rule nonpersistent archived control. Retain every add-hook decision and resulting gate state, first veto/release outcomes, arms/releases/inventory resets, timer/zone/unknown exceptions prevented, elapsed holds. No chronology/outcome input to the gate.
qualification: Same prior screens/minimum20 episodes per HL model. All four baseline digests exact; prior input/source/control artifact hashes pinned. 6 variants x 4 cases only, no after-result additions. Separate persistence effects from whole-policy gain; fresh forward evidence required, no live changes.
persistence: No duration, price or hysteresis tuning. Armed sell15 clears at taker15>0.85; armed confirm_both at taker15>=1.2 AND taker1h>=1; armed sr_confirm additionally ret15>0, without requiring proximity to the old zone. Missing pulse cannot arm, and cannot clear an already armed hold. No new live missing-data policy is deployed.
